title: About — Northwind Robotics
content: Northwind Robotics builds warehouse automation for mid-market third-party logistics operators. Founded in 2019 in Rotterdam by Ines Aldarov and Petro Vance, the company now supports 41 distribution centres across Europe. Our autonomous pick-and-place cells install alongside existing conveyor lines rather than replacing them, which is why a typical deployment goes live in under six weeks.

title: Pricing — Northwind Robotics
content: Northwind prices per successful pick rather than per robot. Customers pay a fixed platform fee plus a per-pick rate that falls as monthly volume rises. We moved to per-pick pricing in 2024 because buyers told us capital budgets were the thing blocking deployment.

title: Northwind Robotics closes Series B — Logistics Weekly
content: Northwind Robotics closed a 24 million euro Series B led by Kettle Row Capital, with participation from Harbour Lane Ventures. The round follows a year in which deployments doubled. Investors pointed to the per-pick pricing switch as the change that unlocked mid-market demand.

title: Episode 42: Ines Aldarov of Northwind Robotics
content: Ines Aldarov: our revenue org is led by Marta Sundqvist, who joined from a freight-forwarding background. Marta rebuilt the commercial team around deployment engineers rather than account executives, because the buyer in this market wants to see the cell running before they sign.
